discriminator.interpretation: Require the exact discriminator mapping tag and validate its selected target, including allOf ancestors. Suppress dispatch only on allOf ancestors. Preserve requiredness, nullability and additionalProperties.
discriminator.positive: An exact mapped tag with its complete selected payload passes.
discriminator.negative: An unmapped tag or missing required selected field fails.
